text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Team <First> was super strong, wasn't it? 
Everyone went zooming past, whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, we'll definitely win next 
time! If we all try even harder, we can 
win! Right, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Rice-chan? What's wrong? Your face is 
pale as a ghost!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Rice... um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I know I'll just cause more trouble for 
everyone...! So... I'm quitting the 
team...!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Rice-chan!?

A few days after our crushing defeat in 
the informal race against Team <First>.

For a while after that, Rice Shower 
stopped showing up to training.

With Rice Shower no longer showing up, the 
team members had become completely 
demoralized.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That is concerning, isn't it...

Come to think of it, she had seemed 
somewhat down ever since that pickup race 
against Team <First>.
choice_data_list: Rice was feeling so responsible, you know.

Rice was feeling really responsible, you 
know.

text_block_list.text:
I was the reason a dispute broke out, and 
I was the reason we lost.

If it's Rice Shower, she might be thinking 
that way.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...During that final race that day, all I 
did was tell Rice to keep fighting...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
“Rice must have been so very scared back 
then, though, yes.”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Without even noticing that, I only 
thought about the team winning..."
Taiki Shuttle let out a small sigh.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"If I hadn't held back and become close 
friends with them, maybe I would've been 
able to understand how they felt."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...I didn't want to disrupt the team, so 
I was holding back a little on making 
friends."

It was true that Taiki Shuttle held back 
on throwing a party, something she'd 
normally do on a whim.

It wasn't just her. Come to think of it, 
the other members were also somewhat 
reserved. Everyone was walking on 
eggshells for the sake of team harmony.

The mystery of why the entire team had 
seemed so stifled was finally solved.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, holding back definitely wasn't the 
right thing to do, yes...?”

"It is good that you tried to be 
cooperative. Without that, a team cannot 
stay united."

However, if we are to grow stronger as a 
team, each of us must unleash our full 
potential.
choice_data_list: From today on, let's not hold back.

text_block_list.text:
“And let's utilize the individuality 
everyone's been holding back for the 
team's sake.” That was the gist of what I 
conveyed.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Stop holding back and embrace our 
individuality... is that it?

For example, Taiki Shuttle is a mood 
maker, but at the same time, she's very 
attentive to others.

If she can show off that personality 
without holding back, she'll become the 
dependable glue holding the team together.

By having our contrasting personalities 
complement each other like that, we aim 
for victory as a team. If we do that—
choice_data_list: We can definitely become a great team.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I thought that being a team meant we had 
to be united no matter what, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Stop holding back and embrace our 
individuality...! Scales have fallen from 
my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer! In that case, I wanna 
talk even more!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I tried not to chat too much during 
training, you know~

Haru Urara's greatest strength is simply 
that she is always positive and full of 
energy.

When the team is feeling down, Haru 
Urara's positive attitude is sure to be a 
reliable boost.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really!? Yay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'd like a fortune reading too! And 
then I want to do a warm-up sprint for 
good luck!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I guess I just felt a little hesitant 
dashing in any direction other than my 
lucky one.

A little novelty, like good luck sprints 
or fortune-telling, should breathe some 
fresh air into things from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Urara helped the team, and Fukukitaru 
brought joy to the team...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I am getting VERY excited! I have a 
feeling we will become a wonderful team!
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can become one.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...! Hehe! You're so right!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Let's go look for Rice!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because Rice's individuality is surely 
something our team needs, yes!
And so—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Rice-chan! Where are youuu?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Rice-chaaan! Come on out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
According to pencil divination, the person 
you're looking for is near a tree! Which 
means Rice-san is right heeeere!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! E-Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower! There's a story I'd really 
love you to hear!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still... Rice was thinking... that maybe I 
should quit the team...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh...! Have you already made up your 
mind...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm no good, and I can't win races 
either... I'll definitely... just cause 
trouble for everyone again."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why... maybe it's better if I just 
quit...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Rice-chan, our team 
absolutely needs you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's not true... I'm sure we'll lose 
again because of Rice...

Seeing Rice Shower so disheartened, the 
members desperately offer words of 
encouragement.

However, perhaps I was too late... Her 
resolve was unyielding, and she stubbornly 
insisted on quitting. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah! I just came up with a nice idea!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today's lucky direction is South! And the 
lucky item is saltwater!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In other words! How about the whole team 
runs toward Enoshima right now!

Whether she noticed her teammates' blank 
stares or not... Matikanefukukitaru 
joyfully carried on.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
From the academy, it should be just over 
40 km! It's a bit far, but we can 
definitely make it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Surely you'll get tons of divine 
blessings, Rice! Your worries will vanish 
into the sky in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait, Enoshima...?

Caught completely off guard, the gloom on 
Rice Shower's face turned into utter 
bewilderment.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fuku-chan, that's amazing! We're all going 
to the beach!? That's gonna be so much 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Urara-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right, right?! And while we're at 
it, let's play on the beach and grab some 
whitebait bowls before heading home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Very, very nice idea! I will go gather 
everyone right away, YES!

Rice Shower called out to Taiki Shuttle as 
she started running.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-Wait a minute, Taiki-san, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, what happened?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... I-It's already evening... Won't 
it be nighttime by the time we get 
there...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-It gets dangerous when it gets dark...!

At Rice Shower's remark, the team fell 
dead silent.

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: True!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That is true! It is evening 
already! Going far at night is a little 
bit dangerous, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"That was dangerous, YES. I'm so glad Rice 
stopped me, YES!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it, having a Rice who can put on 
the brakes like this is exactly why we 
need you on the team!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Our trainer told us not to hold back.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If we stop holding back and bring out the 
best in each other's individuality, our 
team will definitely become stronger!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Rice's careful and caring nature is what 
protects our team, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu! Just like earlier!

Rice Shower's pale face had gradually 
regained its color.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really okay for Rice to be 
here...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If we don't have you, Rice-san, we're 
definitely gonna lose next time too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's always fun when Rice-chan is 
around!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice will do her best...!

From the following day on, Rice Shower 
began coming to training once again.
